name: average models trained on bootstrap resamples
mechanism: draw many resamples of the training set with replacement, train one model on each, and combine their predictions by vote or average, reducing the variance of an unstable learner

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bootstrap aggregating (bagging)' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification: technique to improve stability and classification accuracy
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Random forest': classify using many decision trees

fails_when: no gain on stable learners; correlated models
